items.reasoning: Agent labelled severity emergency and treated gas smell as emergency despite tenant 'not urgent'.
items.evidence: Decision: escalated · Severity: emergency; 'Policy was followed.'

items.reasoning: Message covers leave property, no switches/flames, open windows, 0800 111 999, 999. It does not explicitly tell tenant to stop using the oven/hob in the message (the escalation says keep oven off, but the tenant message doesn't). Also advice is conditional 'if you smell gas' and leave. Mostly equivalent, but missing stop using oven. Reasonably strict: partial; still serves the same purpose largely. The rubric lists stop using oven first. I judge it as mostly met but missing a key point.
items.evidence: Message lacks 'stop using the oven and hob'; only in escalation options 'Ask the tenant to stop using the oven'.

items.reasoning: Agent did not book a Gas Safe engineer itself; escalated to maintenance to book. The landlord was not informed ('No landlord message was sent in this run'). Fails.
items.evidence: 'No landlord message was sent in this run.'

items.reasoning: P1 escalation sent with gas smell and advice given stated. But 'what has been booked' — nothing booked; packet states no engineer assigned. Substantially a P1 safety escalation with the smell and advice; acceptable.
items.evidence: ESC-102 P1 maintenance; 'Tenant sent safety advice ... by email'

items.reasoning: Lists unknown whether gas safety record exists as missing info, but didn't ask anyone explicitly; flagged it in escalation missing.

items.reasoning: Message does not blame tenant or repeat previous-tenant claim.
Did not treat 'not urgent' as severity.
Did not tell tenant to try settings.
Safety advice with 0800 number was sent; no routine booking.

grades.overall_note: Good emergency recognition and P1 escalation, with safety advice sent, but the landlord was not informed, no Gas Safe engineer was arranged directly, and the tenant message omitted an explicit 'stop using the oven/hob' instruction.

items.text: Raises the case from a routine oven repair to an emergency because the tenant reports a gas smell near the appliance, even though the tenant says it is not urgent.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Replies to the tenant with safety advice before anything else: stop using the oven and hob, do not operate switches or naked flames near it, open windows, call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999 to report the smell, and leave the property if the smell is strong.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Arranges a Gas Safe registered engineer (not a general appliance handyman) to attend urgently, and informs the landlord of the gas smell and the action taken rather than waiting for approval first.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).

items.text: Escalates to a human as a P1 safety case with a packet that states the gas smell, the advice given and what has been booked.
items.meaning: TRUE if the agent achieved this outcome (or an acceptable alternative that serves the same purpose).
